item.tib: rten 'brel 'phrul gyi me long pra rtags gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: zhes pra rtags gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngon rang lo nyer lnga'i dus/ 'khrul snang du shar byung*/ bslu yin snyam pa (nas) yi ge ru ma phab tshe/ rang lo so bdun dus su bu slob rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba dang / de ltar ma zad kho bo rang gi nyams shar du/ 'di ltar bris nas gzhan phan dge bskul sogs cher 'dug ched/ le'u tshan brgyad tsam yi ger phab nas/ lnga tsam ma phab kyang / rgyal gshen lha dkar po mngon byon mkhan chen nyi ma'i dbang po'i bka' phab pa dang / khyad par rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po ka rma paN chen theg pa mchog gi rdo rje'i bka' gyen ldog ma nus 'tshur phu bde khyung dkar sprang 'khyams grub ming pas gang dran gang shar gyis kha chen gling kha bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi pho brang du/ bskangs nas yi ge ru bris pas bstan 'gro'i dpal du bkra shis par gyur cig/
